files.hooks/sidepad/index.ts:
export * as default from '.';
export type * from './sidepad';
files.hooks/names/pane-id.ts:
/** The one pane the plugin opens; its `requestId` at `ui.render`, `ui.scroll`, `ui.press`. */
export const PANE_ID = 'sidepad';
files.hooks/names/pane-title.ts:
/** The pane's title: its tab while another pane is open too. */
export const PANE_TITLE = 'sidepad';
files.hooks/names/store-auto-open-key.ts:
/** The `$.store` key of the auto-open switch; unset means on. */
export const STORE_AUTO_OPEN_KEY = 'auto-open';
files.hooks/names/store-theme-key.ts:
/** The `$.store` key of the pane's theme; unset means `auto`. */
export const STORE_THEME_KEY = 'theme';
files.hooks/tools/editing-tools.ts:
/** The tools whose landed call means Claude wrote or edited a file. */
export const EDITING_TOOLS = ['Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit'] as const;
files.hooks/tools/shell-tools.ts:
/** The tools whose completion may have changed, moved or deleted the page shown, with no edit record. */
export const SHELL_TOOLS = ['Bash', 'PowerShell'] as const;
